---
title: "I feel that my contribution to research is recognised by my institution."
question_id: likert4a
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| file: ../R/_load_common.R
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
question_code <- "likert4a"

nordic_countries <- c(
  "Finland", "Norway", "Sweden", "Denmark", "Iceland", "Estonia"
)
country_groups <- list(
  Nordics = nordic_countries,
  Germany = "Germany",
  Netherlands = "Netherlands"
)
plot_countries <- countries_from_groups(country_groups)

df <- load_filtered_tf(plot_countries)
likert_cols <- question_columns(question_code, names(df))
```

## Nordics

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| results: asis

df_nordics <- load_filtered_tf(nordic_countries)

print_likert_items(
  df_nordics,
  likert_cols,
  meta = cols,
  empty_message = "No responses available for Nordic countries in the current filter."
)
```

### Statistics by age group

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

df_nordics <- load_filtered_tf(nordic_countries)

print_likert_items(
  df_nordics,
  likert_cols,
  meta = cols,
  group_by = "age_group",
  include_plot = FALSE,
  heading_level = 4L,
  empty_message = "No responses available for Nordic countries in the current filter."
)
```

#| echo: false
